name: Local-remote command interlock
summary: Accepts commands only from the location selected by the documented authority mechanism.
description: Accepts commands only from the location selected by the documented authority mechanism. An interlocking function permits or blocks an operation according to the positions and conditions of related equipment. Electrical, mechanical and trapped-key interlocks implement different parts of a coordinated operating philosophy.

In a switchgear feeder panel, a control diagram can prevent an incompatible combination of breaker, disconnector and earthing-switch positions. The physical equipment documents determine which restrictions are mechanically enforced. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Authority selector and command” at the input and “Accepted command path” at the output. Indication and operating authority are separate signals.
